verdict.rationale: Building the runtime from source is a fair question for an on-device inference SDK. The evidence pack contains no build-from-source instructions or dependency documentation. The C++ core and the GitHub repo are mentioned only in marketing terms, and a community comment notes that the MetalRT engine is proprietary, which suggests the core runtime may not be buildable from source at all.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build the runtime from source with minimal external dependencies
